description: Hand-coded political lean of the Agree (pole +) position for each subjective statement, 2020s-US coding. 'ambiguous' marks genuinely cross-cutting issues (civil liberties, antitrust, NATO, nuclear) where Agree is not clearly left- or right-coded. Tally: 8 left / 6 right / 6 ambiguous; both splits are 4/3/3. Consumed by dashboard/build_appendix.py.
